messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — planning to publish the v1->v2 migration + model-swap announcement tomorrow 09:00 PST. Draft PR here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427. Need a final pass on SDK snippets (TS + Py) and a short compatibility shim example for teams that can't upgrade immediately.

docs-bot: PR opened by @maya — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427 (status: open, reviewers: @zack, @olivia).

Zack Patel: Skimmed the PR, overall good. Two quick nits: the TS snippet still uses `client.models.swapModel(...)` which is gone in v2, and the auth env var example should be `REDWOOD_API_KEY` -> `REDWOOD_KEY`. I can push a tiny commit to fix both.

Maya Chen: thanks — the SDK change is `client.models.swapModel` -> `client.model.swap`. Also the call signature changed from `(fromModel, toModel, options)` to `(toModel, {force, reason})`. Example in PR currently shows old signature, so that needs updating.

Kevin O'Neill: We should also call out streaming/response format differences in the migration guide. v2 streaming uses server-sent events with a `delta` field instead of chunked text frames — customers relying on naive parsers will break. Add a short section and a link to the streaming migration snippet.

Olivia Park: I'll update the sample-app repo with a compatibility shim and a test. Proposed shim (JS):
```
// simple v1->v2 shim for swapModel
export function createCompatibilityClientV1(apiKey) {
  const c = new Client({ apiKey: apiKey });
  return {
    swapModel: (from, to, opts) => c.model.swap(to, { force: opts?.force, reason: opts?.reason })
  }
}
```
This keeps callers able to call `swapModel(from, to, opts)` while using the new runtime. I'll open a PR in sample-app and link it here.

Zack Patel: Nice shim. Add a short comment about telemetry: warn users that shimmed calls won't preserve v1 telemetry tags unless we map them explicitly. Could add a small `console.warn` in dev mode.

Maya Chen: Good point about telemetry — add that to the migration checklist bullet list in the PR. Also, can someone run the link-checker on the doc branch? I found a broken link to the old model catalog page.

docs-bot: Link check started for branch maya/migration-1427 — 1 broken link found: /docs/models/catalog -> should be /docs/models/catalog-v2.

Olivia Park: I'll fix the link in the doc and in sample-app readme. Also will add a short note in the release notes about Dedicated behavior for model swaps (warmup time).

Kevin O'Neill: For the announcement email, we should include an explicit deprecation timeline: v1 endpoints deprecated in 30 days, automatic redirects for 14 days, and a hard cutoff at 45 days. Can legal/ops review SLA language?

Maya Chen: Yup — I'll ping legal once docs + sample-app changes land. Final ask: reviewers please prioritize the PR this morning so we can schedule the announcement. Tag me when merged and I'll coordinate the email + console banner. :party_parrot:
